title: Crispy Chicken Strips with Garlic-Herb Aioli
description: Crispy golden chicken strips marinated in buttermilk, coated with a light double crust, and served with a rich garlic-herb aioli. Perfect as a Continental appetizer or main course.

ingredients.title: For the Chicken Strips
items: Chicken breast – 600 g (boneless, skinless, cut into 1.5 × 10 cm strips)

ingredients.title: For the Coating
items: Cold sparkling water – as needed (about 100 ml, to create light dredge)

ingredients.title: For Frying
items: Neutral oil (canola, sunflower, or grapeseed) – for deep frying

ingredients.title: For the Garlic-Herb Aioli
items: Garlic – 2 cloves, roasted and finely minced

instruction.title: Step 1 – Marinate the Chicken
steps: In a bowl, combine buttermilk, Dijon mustard, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add chicken strips, coat well, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours (or overnight for maximum tenderness).

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Coating
steps: Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, pepper, and thyme.
Remove chicken from marinade; let excess drip off.
Dip in a splash of cold sparkling water, then dredge again for a crispy double crust.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Fry
steps: Fry strips in small batches for 4–5 minutes, until golden and internal temperature reaches 74 °C (165 °F).
Drain on paper towel and season lightly with sea salt while hot.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Make the Garlic-Herb Aioli
steps: Whisk egg yolks, mustard, garlic, and lemon juice.
Slowly drizzle in olive and neutral oils, whisking constantly until emulsified.
Fold in herbs and season with salt.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Plating & Presentation
steps: Serve chicken strips on a slate or textured plate.
Place aioli in a small ramekin or squeeze-bottle swirl.
Garnish with microgreens, smoked paprika dust, and a lemon wedge.
For a luxury touch: drizzle with truffle oil or serve with a parmesan crisp.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Pair with a light herb salad or grilled asparagus.
Garnish with a lemon wedge for extra freshness.

chefTips: Sparkling water keeps the batter light and airy.
Double dredge ensures crunch without greasiness.
Always rest the fried chicken for 2–3 minutes on a rack for oil to drain evenly.
For a refined twist, pair with a light herb salad or grilled asparagus.
